Review compared the preserved public preimages with the current source and
checked all 22 final process records and matching before/after snapshots.

Original provider delegation, exact supplied-context strong ownership,
independent nullable image/context properties, private action-context isolation,
and live Canvas handle ownership are coherent. Targeted reentry controls cover
same-target image completion, inherited context flags, nested explicit NULL,
row-destruction refresh replacement and parent-notify image ABA/newer popup.

queues renderer work, clears context, proves release, drains callbacks and
